fields.label: Guest Booking Portal Enabled
fields.description: Master switch for the public /book portal. When off, hotel_erp.www.book.get_context serves a closed notice instead of the booking app, and every hotel_erp.api.public_booking write/read endpoint refuses with the message below -- so disabling here blocks both the page and the API, not just navigation.

fields.label: Closed Message
fields.default: Online booking is temporarily unavailable. Please call us to reserve a room.
